items.summaryOriginal: Micron Technology is reaping the rewards of the memory-chip boom but, with Chinese companies eager to get in on the action, it needs to get moving on its next generation of hardware. Yangtze Memory Technologies, or YMTC, has filed for an initial public offering in Shanghai to raise $4.9 billion. It’s not exactly a surprise after Chinese peer CXMT’s blockbuster IPO, but it still means more funds flowing into products that compete with Micron’s.
